    Profile

    Even among her bloodline of shamans, Peridot is seen as exceptionally gifted. She lives in the remote forests of the Saga Region. Because she rarely comes across people and since she suffers from social anxiety as well, her style of speech is always like that of an oracle. Whenever her emotions get stirred up, she has the habit of becoming cold and blunt, so even though she'd love to make friends, she hasn't managed to.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 157cm
    Weight: 45kg
    Birthday: Jan 9
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Crystals
    Hobbies: Secretly watching things that look fun
    Illust: ―
    CV: 佐藤美由希
